_comment: Drop this into .claude/settings.json (per-project) or merge into ~/.claude/settings.json (per-user). Adjust paths and permissions to taste.
_context_window_note: ORCH_CONTEXT_WINDOW_TOKENS defaults to 1000000 — the handoff assumes the controller runs on Opus / the latest Claude Code model (1M context window). Set it lower (e.g. 200000) only if you run the controller on a smaller-window model like Haiku.
_handoff_tokens_note: ORCH_CONTEXT_HANDOFF_TOKENS (default 120000) is an ABSOLUTE token floor that nudges a handoff before native auto-compaction (which fires near ~150K tokens). On a 1M window the 70% warn threshold (700K) sits far above that native trigger, so the absolute floor — not the percentage — is what fires in time. The advisory fires each turn while above the floor (like the per-turn protocol reminder) until a handoff resets the session. Lower it to hand off earlier; raise it past your window to disable the floor and rely on the percentage only. ORCH_CONTEXT_BLOCK_TOKENS (default 140000) is the matching absolute ceiling for the strict-profile block, so strict enforcement engages before native compaction on a large window.
_hooks_note: If you installed via --copy (not as a plugin), add hook entries here using Claude Code's settings.json hook schema. See docs/install.md → 'Wiring hooks for a --copy install' for the full example. If you installed as a plugin, hooks come from .claude-plugin/plugin.json automatically — leave this block out.
